sentences.text:
_ __
 Coram: G. S. Kulkarni &
 Aarti Sathe, Jj.
There is a dispute regarding the apportionment of the compensation in respect of the Land Acquisition Award as published under the Maharashtra Highways Act, 1955.
The concern of the Petitioner is that the compensation ought not have been disbursed to the private Respondent No.3-Mr. Pratik Laxman Patil.
Let the learned AGP take instructions and place the correct position on record on the adjourned date of hearing.
We also permit the Petitioner to serve Respondent No.3 by all private modes of service.
2. Till the adjourned date of hearing, Respondent No.2 shall not disburse any compensation, if not already disbursed.
